proof_body:
by
  intro s n
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero =>
    intro h1 h2
    have h1' : 0 < s + 1 := by push_cast at h1 h2; linarith
    have h2' : s < 0 := by push_cast at h1 h2; linarith
    have hne : s ≠ 0 := h2'.ne
    have := Real.Gamma_add_one hne
    have hp := Real.Gamma_pos_of_pos h1'
    rw [this] at hp
    have : Real.Gamma s < 0 := by
      by_contra hc
      push Not at hc
      have := mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg h2'.le hc
      linarith
    simp
    linarith
  | succ n ih =>
    intro h1 h2
    push_cast at h1 h2
    have h1' : -((n:ℝ) + 1) < s + 1 := by linarith
    have h2' : s + 1 < -(n:ℝ) := by linarith
    have hs : s < 0 := by have : (0:ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n; linarith
    have hne : s ≠ 0 := hs.ne
    have key := ih (s + 1) h1' h2'
    rw [Real.Gamma_add_one hne] at key
    have : (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 + 1) * Real.Gamma s * (-s) = (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1) * (s * Real.Gamma s) := by
      rw [pow_succ]; ring
    have hneg : 0 < -s := by linarith
    have h3 : 0 < (-1 : ℝ) ^ (n + 1 + 1) * Real.Gamma s * (-s) := by rw [this]; exact key
    exact (pos_iff_pos_of_mul_pos h3).mpr hneg
